design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQV uses P=1.3 in (90th percentile); runoff coefficient R=0.05+0.009(I). Infiltration suitability threshold 0.3 in/hr (HSG A/B); pretreatment required if soil infiltration >8.3 in/hr. SHGT: 36 in (3 ft) recommended below infiltration system bottom; reducible to 24 in (2 ft) in limited cases; unlined filtering systems min 12 in (1 ft) above SHGT. QPA requires ≥18 in depth to SHGT. Bioretention trees min 30 in media depth; media design permeability 0.5 in/hr (1.0 ft/day). ED basins require ≥24 h detention storage; full drawdown ≤48 h. Table 8-7 notes >48 h extended detention for bacteria at ponds/wetlands—not assigned to wetland_detention_hours.
